_comment: Single source of truth for the npm version pins that every *_portal/package.json must carry identically. npm has no cross-package sharing without a workspace, so the values still live in each package.json — but this file is the canonical declaration and the portal-bundles CI (override-pins + dep-pins jobs) fails if any portal drifts from it. Bump a pin HERE, then mirror it into all five package.json (and refresh each lockfile).
_comment_deps: `deps` = the shared framework versions every one of the five portals MUST declare identically (in dependencies or devDependencies). The `dep-pins` CI job fails if any portal is missing one or carries a different spec. `optionalDeps` = shared deps that only some portals use (e.g. socket.io-client, only the realtime portals fleet/driver/safety); pinned only where present, so a portal that does not use it is not forced to add it, but any portal that does must match.
